plausibility.question: P1 gravity
plausibility.answer: Foot underside y -70.000 is the lowest plane with -Y down (A-07); the mount's centre of mass (0.01, -28.54, -8.31) lies over the foot footprint; the thermoblock hangs on two screws in front of the vertical plate with its axis horizontal.

plausibility.question: P2 function chains
plausibility.answer: Screw chain plate bore D4.0 -> spacer bore D4.0 -> OD-H11 hole is coaxial at both points (offset 0.000); pipes and terminals at +Y stay clear (mount at z <= -10.10 behind the base face and y <= -66 below the body); see F4 on the S1 entry lip.

plausibility.question: P4 grip, reach, insertion
plausibility.answer: Thermoblock screws go in from the plate back along +Z through the bores; the thermoblock with spacers approaches along -Z and first touches at the designed spacer contacts (path clearance equals remaining travel, nothing else touches); foot screws go along -Y, heads 1.25 clear of the plate face at z -8, and the z 26 pair goes in before the thermoblock.

plausibility.question: P5 comparable product
plausibility.answer: An L bracket with a rear plate, two short bosses and metal spacers is a normal heater mount; the 37.7 x D7.0 metal column at S2 is unusual but not absurd.

plausibility.question: P6 floating, embedded, mirrored, upside-down
plausibility.answer: One solid; spacers touch both ends at 0.000 with 0.000 mm3 overlap with the mount and no probe point inside the casting; bores coaxial with the measured OD-H11 holes (not mirrored); teardrop apexes point +Z; foot at -Y.

findings.required: Soft: holds the thermoblock through a heating cycle without softening (bench)
findings.at: whole mount; hottest printed surfaces the S1 tip 10.10 from the base face and the S2 tip under a 37.70 metal column
findings.risk_basis: Not measurable in CAD (INCONCLUSIVE); ASA softens near 100 C and the mount sits 10.1 mm from a >100 C casting with a metal spacer conducting heat into each standoff tip (A-05, A-08).
findings.fix_direction: Answer on the bench at the first heating run (tip temperature and any creep of the standoffs), or name PC per A-08 before printing.

findings.risk_basis: The 0.100 margin is about a fifth of the scan's p95 error 0.474 (A-01); clamped, the S1 gap equals the S1 spacer's length, so a spacer cut 0.10 short takes the whole margin, and A-05 states no length tolerance.
findings.fix_direction: Retire A-01/A-03 with calipers on the base face and S1 hole before printing, and give the spacer lengths a +0.10/-0 tolerance in A-05; or lower both tips (e.g. to -10.60, spacers 10.60 / 38.20) to hold 10.0 at the scan's p95 error.

findings.at: OD-H11 pairs; common_volume refused: BOPAlgo_InvalidCurveOnSurface on OD-H11
findings.risk_basis: INCONCLUSIVE by the ratified row (A-14); distance rows read mount|OD-H11 10.100 and spacer ends 0.000 with inside false, and 0 of 6480 classifier points per spacer lie in the casting (control FAILs at 0.5 mm overlap).
findings.fix_direction: A sound rebuild of OD-H11 in open-dedica (A-14) lets the boolean run; no mount change.

findings.required: screw path of the assumed D3.5 screw clear to r 1.75 about the S1 axis (A-03, A-04)
findings.at: OD-H11 S1 entry, z 0.0 .. 3.0, angles 255 .. 325 deg about (-19.62, 20.18): the base-face lip reaches r 1.344 (at 300 deg); the D3.60 pilot starts at z 3.0
findings.risk_basis: Input geometry, not the mount; the lip is within the scan's error (A-01) and a thread-forming D3.5 screw may cut it, but the scanned D3.60 pilot is itself larger than a D3.5 screw, so the screw and seat choice (A-03, A-04) is not settled by the scan.
findings.fix_direction: Measure the S1 hole entry and the OEM screw (A-03, A-04) before choosing the screw; if the lip is real, a stepped spacer or a spigot into the notch (plan R3) seats and guides the screw; no mount change needed.

least_sure_answers.item: 1. REQ-01 at S1 has 0.100 margin against a scan with p95 0.474
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed: 10.100 mm at the S1 tip rim, same against the input OD-H11 file; clamped, the gap is the S1 spacer length, so the tip's +-0.10 does not reach REQ-01 but the spacer's cut length does; rated MEDIUM in F2.

S1 spacer bears on 32 % of its end annulus (angles 225 .. 350 deg about the S1 axis, about 125 deg), S2 all round (100 %); the base-face lip also narrows the S1 screw entry to r 1.344 (F4); plate-to-foot and gusset edges are sharp (19 sharp concave edges); strength stays a bench question (A-11).

least_sure_answers.item: 3. Contact rows exact only at nominal
least_sure_answers.answer: True of the model (spacers fixed, tips +-0.10); in the clamped assembly the spacer sets the tip-to-seat distance, the mount moves instead, and tips 0.20 apart tilt the block by about 0.25 deg over the 45.99 mm between the screw axes; no gate is affected at nominal.
